items.title: SD-106 acceptance re-measurement at P0a epochs=40: does bottleneck variance preservation reach PCA-32 parity at the consumer rung on a raised budget?
items.note: SD-106's ACCEPTANCE RE-MEASUREMENT AT A RAISED P0a BUDGET -- the primary /queue-experiment routed by the CONFIRMED autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1041_2026-09-16 (recommended_writes_for_governance[10]; user gate 2026-09-16T13:06:22Z; applied by governance-20260916, REE_assembly db6d20ebee). | MANIPULATION: ONE integer -- ZWorldP0Config.epochs 12 -> 40 on the SD-106 P0a warmup (V3-EXQ-1041's b_steps1200 cell, which it executed 6 times). No new driver: this is a thin wrapper that overrides exactly two x1023 module functions (_warm_sd106_agent, _config_slice) and calls x1023.run_experiment unchanged, so every threshold, gate, anchor certificate and readout is the acceptance measurement's own code. preservation_weight stays 200.0 -- the V3-EXQ-1023 refusal to bump it STANDS. | ACCEPTANCE TARGET (pre-set by governance gov-20260911, NOT invented here, imported from x1023 rather than restated): >= 0.85 held-out oracle-action agreement at the consumer rung (x734.PPOPolicyNet at PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN, arm zworld_sd106__mlp128) on a seed majority (2 of 3). C1 is the ONLY load-bearing criterion and is an ABSOLUTE bar against the PCA-32 anchor. | WHAT FALSIFIES WHAT: pre-registered predictions, RECORDED AND NOT ROUTED ON -- ~0.806 under H-transfer-amplification (the preservation code's extra world-obs content transfers monotonically to oracle-action agreement) vs ~0.719 under H-which-directions (it preserves more variance but not more decision-relevant direction); ~0.09 separation on the shipped DV. Both sit BELOW the 0.85 bar, so the likeliest outcome is a FAIL that still discriminates -- stated up front so a FAIL is not read as a wasted cycle. Both are EXISTING legs on the EXISTING question zworld_actor_adequacy_locus; this run opens no leg and edits no registry file. Verdict grid: C1 met on a seed majority -> PASS sd106_reaches_pca32_parity; C1 unmet -> FAIL sd106_below_pca32_parity; any declared control red (instrument rawfield floor, PCA-32 anchor, latent collapse, or the new budget precondition) -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a substrate verdict. | THE ONE-KNOB PROOF. resolve_p0a_config FORCES epochs=2 under --dry-run, so the smoke cannot witness epochs=40. It is proved instead by (a) --self-test asserting the non-dry resolved config is epochs=40 while the predecessor's default resolves to 12, and (b) a REAL-RUN precondition sd106_p0a_n_steps_supra_shipped that reads p0a_n_steps BACK OFF THE TRAINER on every SD-106 cell against a floor of 1000, scoped out (never failed) under --dry-run. The floor is certified at setup by assert_anchor_reachable against V3-EXQ-1041's own recorded cells (1320/1320/1160 at epochs=40; 396/396/348 at epochs=12), and the self-test carries the negative control that the floor REJECTS the shipped budget. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = oracle-action agreement at mlp128 on an SD-106-ON latent trained at P0a epochs=40. Checked V3-EXQ-1023 (ran the same instrument at epochs=12) and V3-EXQ-1041 (ran epochs=40 but is P0-warmup-only, no decoder ladder, DV is R^2 not agreement). No recorded manifest carries it on any substrate_hash -- NOT recoverable, run required. | Step 2.5 SD-106 IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md:426). Step 2.5a probe CONFIRMS the premise: resolve_p0a_config(dry_run=False, config=ZWorldP0Config(epochs=40)) resolves to epochs=40 with preservation_weight 200.0 intact, and use_world_encoder_skip reaches SplitEncoder. Step 2.5b re-derive brake on SD-106 = 0 hits. | Step 2.5c: MEASURED, not assumed. Of the four open corrupting substrate_queue entries on origin/master, three do NOT overlap this driver -- MECH-320 (policy/tonic_vigor.py), sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration (affect/blocked_agency.py) and sd105_frozen_shared_entropy_floor_multiplier (regulators/selection_entropy_floor.py) are imported but CONFIG-DISABLED on the x724 all-ON stack (use_tonic_vigor / use_blocked_agency / use_selection_entropy_floor all False, and agent.tonic_vigor / .blocked_agency / .selection_entropy_floor all None -- probed on a constructed agent). The ONE genuine overlap is contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write; agent.e1 is live), which is EXACTLY the entry covered by the SCOPED USER EXCEPTION of 2026-09-11 recorded verbatim in V3-EXQ-1023's own queue note -- granted because V3-EXQ-1010, the run governance pre-set as this acceptance measurement, already executed under it and the comparison is PAIRED. Same lineage, same instrument, same paired design; carried forward, not newly granted. Recorded so the manifest and any later autopsy see the limitation. | GFLAG-0286: x1010._best_over_rungs applies NO diverged-row filter. Disposition = REPORTED, NOT EXCLUDED (manifest diverged_cells + readout.n_diverged_cells). Excluding would change the instrument the acceptance target names as unchanged and break comparability with V3-EXQ-1023/1010; and the hazard cannot touch the verdict anyway, because C1 reads x1010._cell(rows, zworld_sd106__mlp128, seed) directly and never calls _best_over_rungs. | DV-SYMMETRY INVARIANCE, per track. The DV is held-out oracle-action agreement -- an argmax over a freshly-fitted decoder's logits, whose symmetry group is (per-candidate) order-preserving transforms of those logits. zworld_sd106: the manipulation changes the ENCODER'S OBJECTIVE AND BUDGET, hence the 32-dim input the decoder is fitted on, hence which function is learnable -- it is not a broadcast constant, a monotone rescaling of candidate scores, or a permutation of interchangeable units, so the DV is not invariant under it. zworld_off / ws250_pca / rawfield_ceiling are UNMANIPULATED reference tracks: they carry no manipulation to be invariant under, and exist to locate the bar and to prove the instrument can read the label at all. | PRE-REGISTERED LIMITATION (red-team F1, fixed documentarily and recorded machine-readably as manifest off_arm_budget): the OFF track is NOT budget-matched. x1010._warm_off_agent passes no zworld_p0_config (v3_exq_1010_...py:1087), so OFF trains at the default epochs=12. It is a shipped-budget REFERENCE, not a matched control, and every ON-minus-OFF delta in this manifest therefore confounds the preservation term with 3.3x more Adam steps. Those deltas are CONTEXT ONLY and nothing routes on them -- C1 is an absolute bar against a budget-independent PCA anchor and both discrimination predictions are agreement LEVELS, not deltas. NOT repaired by adding an OFF@40 arm because that is a new arm, outside the one-config-knob routing governance ratified, at ~33% more warmup compute, to de-confound a quantity nothing routes on; a budget-matched consumer-rung contrast is a successor letter. | red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 3 findings, ALL 3 FIXED, 0 dismissed, and each reviewer's own cheap confirmer shipped as a --self-test assertion. F1 the unmatched OFF budget (above); F2 _postprocess overwrote degeneracy_reason with 'the epochs=40 knob did not reach the trainer' when x1023's gate had short-circuited before ANY SD-106 cell ran, recording a false cause for a later autopsy -> the override now fires only when SD-106 cells actually ran, and a scoped-out C3 declares threshold_not_applicable instead of a numeric bar the indexer would recompute MET from; F3 _worst_p0a_steps silently dropped a cell that reported no p0a_n_steps, so two good seeds plus one refused seed recorded measured=1320 passed=True -> a non-reporting cell now scores as 0 (the worst cell), keeping `measured` the same statistic `met` tests. | V3-EXQ-1041 context carried in manifest prior_evidence_context rather than re-measured: the in-training preservation_holdout.r2 is a jointly-SGD-trained head metric that UNDER-READS the same code on the same buffer and split by 0.0979/0.0967/0.1289 absolute R^2 and is a LOWER BOUND; the post-hoc OLS probe (0.951 as-shipped -> 0.980 at this budget, of the in-run PCA-32 ceiling) is CITED from V3-EXQ-1041, which measured exactly this cell, and NOT recomputed here -- building it needs that run's observation-capture apparatus, a second instrument rather than a config knob; the SD-106 design doc's 0.9974/0.9978 obs-R^2 table is on a DIFFERENT observation distribution (PCA-32 of the P0a buffer reaches only 0.888 held-out / 0.893 in-sample on seed 42, cross-seed held-out median 0.886), so those absolutes are not comparable to any P0a acceptance number; and V3-EXQ-1041's shortfall decomposition is ORDER-DEPENDENT -- metric-first routes metrics_never_comparable, budget-first routes under_budgeted_p0a (budget 0.769 median), order-symmetric routes its own tie branch no_dominant_explanation (metric 0.404 / budget 0.475 / residual 0.104) -- all three recorded so no reader treats either partition as settled. | SUPERSESSION: `supersedes: V3-EXQ-1023` is provenance only. Per CLAUDE.md, a bare `supersedes` hands nothing to governance, so a governance_flag (evidence_discrepancy) is raised separately for /governance to decide whether V3-EXQ-1023's evidence_direction becomes `superseded`. Both runs are experiment_purpose=diagnostic and already excluded from confidence/conflict scoring. | experiment_purpose=diagnostic, stated not assumed: this DOES re-measure a pre-set acceptance target, but re-measuring a SUBSTRATE acceptance target is a READINESS verdict on a landed design decision (/implement-substrate Step 8), not governance evidence for a mechanism hypothesis -- SD-106 is a design decision, a PASS routes a BUILD decision, and comparability with the predecessor this run supersedes requires the same class. PROMOTES NOTHING on its own.
